rules.reason: The item's DetailFrame body scrolls (1013 px in the 766 px window): Figma's item runs on under the tab bar, and the render's page runs under the pinned tab bar (AppShell tabBarOverlay) the same way (deviations.md "Under the tab bar.").
The item tabs scroll sideways on the phone (438 px of tabs in 366): Activity runs past the screen's right edge in Figma's tab row too (deviations.md "Item tabs.").

The Linked from panel's body scrolls sideways (388 px in 332): a long file and line does not fit beside its node in the 332 px row, and Figma runs it past the panel's and the frame's edge; the render keeps it on one line rather than cut or wrap it (deviations.md "Long file and line.").

position.reason: Figma draws the Links graph's side node icon (icon/workflow 500:11127) at 13 px; MapNode draws it at 16, or at 12 with nodeDensity="compact", which also draws the open item's icon at 12 against Figma's 15 and moves every name 4 px left, so the graph keeps the default 16 (LIBRARY_GAPS.md, Links graph and MapNode icon size).

Figma draws the Links graph's side node icon (icon/skill 500:11131) at 13 px; MapNode draws it at 16, or at 12 with nodeDensity="compact", which also draws the open item's icon at 12 against Figma's 15 and moves every name 4 px left, so the graph keeps the default 16 (LIBRARY_GAPS.md, Links graph and MapNode icon size).
